meta.name: review-documentation
meta.description: This skill should be invoked by a review orchestrator (e.g. `reviewer:self-review`) to review documentation for accuracy, completeness, structure, staleness, and link integrity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 校验文档准确、完整、结构清晰且链接有效
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要确保项目文档不过时、不缺失、链接不失效。
copy.tagline_en: Validate documentation for accuracy, completeness, structure, and working links.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to keep project docs accurate, up-to-date, and well-structured.

howto.what: 这个技能让 AI 审查文档:检查准确性、完整性、结构、过时内容和链接有效性。它会先确定要审的文件或目录,再对照代码库核实文档描述是否属实,最后列出发现的问题。
howto.when: 当审查编排器(如 `reviewer:self-review`)调用本技能时触发。

say.text: 审查这份 README.md,和代码核对一下是否准确。
say.note: 会按技能流程检查并报告问题。

say.text: 审查 docs 目录下的文档,重点检查链接是否失效。
say.note: 会先定位目录内的文档再逐一检查。

say.text: 检查当前目录的文档有没有过时内容,对照代码看看。
say.note: 会加载默认或本地规则检查。

howto.what_en: This skill makes the AI review docs for accuracy, completeness, structure, staleness, and link integrity. It scopes to given files or a directory, cross-checks with code, and reports issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a review orchestrator (e.g. `reviewer:self-review`) invokes this skill.

say_en.text: Review this README.md and check it against the code for accuracy.
say_en.note: Launches the doc review flow and reports issues.

say_en.text: Review the docs directory and check for broken links.
say_en.note: Finds doc files in the directory and checks each one.

say_en.text: Check current docs for stale info and cross-check with code.
say_en.note: Applies default or local review rules.
